description: Find an address anywhere in the world (OpenStreetMap Nominatim). Returns {address, lat, lon, countryCode}; countryCode is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case. The land-registry tools (get_parcel_by_*, import_parcel) work only for countryCode 'pl'; elsewhere set the garden's place with set_geo_anchor and the plot's boundary with set_boundary. The match is fuzzy: when the result carries `approximate: true` (another place, or the house number not found) it is NOT the address asked for: do not take it for the plot.

address.description: Address or place to find, e.g., 'Warszawa, Marszałkowska 1' or '10 Downing Street, London'

name: geocode_address
